cards.name: Petristar

effects.text: Target an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it.

cards.flavorText: It always charges ahead into enemy lines. As if it is afraid of falling behind.

cards.name: Sun Spawn

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

cards.flavorText: Even before breaking free from its shell, its fighting spirit burns fiercely. This is truly the child of the crimson sky.

cards.name: Scud Beast

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.flavorText: The moment you think you're just looking at a drifting cloud, claws and fangs suddenly shoot out of it. It's the perfect ambush.

cards.name: Kukulakatol

effects.text: Target a Spirit card with [Clash] in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: That tail does not merely crush the enemy. It pierces right through the ground.

cards.name: Pergasos

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

cards.flavorText:
I seem to recall seeing a race featuring a horse with such a mane of flame. Well, that horse didn't have wings, mind you...
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

cards.name: Pawgriffo

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It charges again and again with unexpected ferocity. Perhaps it is because there is a rival right beside it.

cards.name: Glitail

effects.text: Target an opposing Spirit with the same BP as this Spirit. Destroy it.
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

cards.flavorText: He charges again and again with astonishing boldness. Perhaps it's because he got a worthy rival close to him.

cards.name: Cockadrice

effects.text: Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. For each Spirit with [Clash] you control, the targeting BP gets +1000.

cards.flavorText: Although it can't turn its enemies into stones with its breath, it can turn them into charcoal.

cards.name: The RedGuide Shaniel

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
All your Spirits with [Clash] gain +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: It is said that there is no end to those who seek that whip, be they foe or friend.

cards.name: The FlyingDauntless Falconiforme
cards.jpName: 飛勇ファルコニフォーメ

effects.text: Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it. If you control any exhausted "Windfang" family Spirit, change the targeting BP to 5000 or less instead.

cards.flavorText: His gaze is as sharp as the point of a spear.

cards.name: Gino-Ankh

effects.text: Target an opposing Nexus. Destroy it

cards.flavorText: To solve this Spirit's riddle requires both considerable knowledge and nerve.

cards.name: Regulinaz

effects.text: [LV1-2] (During Attack) Invoke Flash (Once Per Turn) Discard a "Windfang" family card from your Hand ▶ During this battle, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Distance is irrelevant when facing this Spirit. No matter how far away it is, it closes the gap in an instant.

cards.name: Thorel

effects.text: [LV1-2] [Clash](During Attack) Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, you can target up to three of your Spirits with [Clash]. Send up to a total of three cores, besides , from your Trash to them.

cards.flavorText: "O Lord! Behold my valor!"

cards.name: The DragonSteed Rostache

effects.text: [LV1-2] (When Summoned) Target a Cost 5 or less Red Spirit card in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.
Target an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit. Destroy it.

cards.flavorText: Majestic and beautiful. Its presence is truly a sign of good fortune.

cards.name: Protomaia

effects.text: [LV2] (True Release) [Clash] (During Attack) Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

cards.flavorText: Do not underestimate it just because it is made of clouds. Its power can't be stopped even by steel.

cards.name: Bonrat

effects.text: Target an opposing Cost 3 or less exhausted Spirit. Destroy it.

cards.flavorText: The guide and light of the dark forest.

cards.name: Imseid

effects.text: Target one of your Spirits with [Shamanism]. During this turn, give it +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
Apparently, in this new world, you'd better keep an eye on your own shadow. That's because it sometimes starts moving on its own.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

cards.name: Dead Laika

effects.text: If you control any Spirit with [Shamanism], this Spirit gains +2000 BP.
Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: "Risking one's life". What on earth does that mean, coming from an immortal being?

cards.name: Bullkleiten

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.flavorText:
Apparently, its head originally had skin and flesh. It is said that it ended up looking like this after repeated assaults.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

cards.name: Odonatta

effects.text: This Spirit gains +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: That bewitching light threatens to steal both the eyes and the heart.

cards.name: Spectrous

effects.timing: [LV1-2] Shaman Dark Puce & Cost 2 or less (When Summoned)
effects.text: You can target a Cost 2 or less "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.
This Spirit gains +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: To this Spirit, life and death differ no more than sleep and waking.

cards.name: Centicade

effects.text: All your Spirits with [Shamanism] gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The victims never even had a chance to scream. That’s because it bites into their heads first.

cards.name: The VioletScreech Dracuroar

effects.text: Target an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Send cores from it to the Reserve until one core remains. (The opponent chooses which cores to send)

cards.flavorText: One cannot hear that scream to the very end. For the eardrums cannot endure it.

cards.name: The SpyButterfly Papilioni

effects.timing: [LV1-2] Shaman Dark Puce & Cost 3 or less (When Summoned)
effects.text: You can target a Cost 3 or less "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.
Target an opposing Cost 3 or less exhausted Spirit. Destroy it.

cards.flavorText: "There're no tricks, and no gimmicks at all~"

cards.name: Dulla-Coshta

effects.timing: [LV1-2] Shaman Dark Puce & Cost 3 or less (When Summoned)
effects.text: You can target a Cost 3 or less "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.
Target an opposing Spirit. Send a core, besides , from it to the Reserve.

cards.flavorText: He used to carry a shield, but after having his head cut off, he abandoned defence and took up dual-wielding.

cards.name: Borzo-Inu

effects.text: Draw a card. If any opposing Spirit was depleted/destroyed by your Spirit/Magic effect this turn, draw two cards instead.

cards.flavorText: It regards other living creatures as nothing more than bags filled with a warm, salty, red liquid.

cards.name: Leben-Leichnam

effects.text: Destroy this Spirit ▶ Target a "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Return it to the Hand.

cards.flavorText: Multiple souls were placed within the empty body, and it began to walk once more.

cards.name: The MysticPurple Baphomendes

effects.text: Target an opposing Spirit. Send a core, besides , from it to the Reserve. For each Spirit with [Shamanism] you control, send +1 core.
For each Spirit with [Shamanism] you control, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: "I think it’s about time I got myself a new set of beanbags."

cards.name: Beelzeret

effects.text: [LV1-2](When Summoned) Target an opposing Spirit. Send one core from it to the Reserve. (The opponent chooses which core to send.)

cards.flavorText: If one dons the skin of a beast and behaves like one, then one is surely a beast.

cards.name: The DancingFox Charles de Peta
cards.jpName: 踊狐シャルル・ド・ぺータ

effects.text: [LV1-2] Shaman Dark Puce & Cost 7 or less (When Summoned) You can target a Cost 7 or less "Dark Puce" family Spirit card in your Trash. Summon it.

cards.flavorText: 「……(Overwhelmed, unable to utter a sound?)」

galleryImages.caption: The DancingFox Charles de Peta — Card Art

cards.name: Harshee

effects.text: This Spirit can't attack.

cards.flavorText: "There you go!"

cards.name: Regatracus

effects.text: This Spirit gains +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be a sign of impending danger, or a sign of good things to come.

cards.name: Kurapora

effects.text: You can target an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit. Exhaust it.

cards.flavorText: The awareness of being a front-line soldier, the affection for those he must protect...All these were visible deep within his eyes.

cards.name: Salakka

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to your Trash. If you control any Spirit with [Current], put the core to this Spirit instead.

cards.flavorText: He may look as though he is just playing around, but his magical powers are very real.

cards.name: Alotoll

effects.timing: [LV2](True Release) Current Oceanic Green & Cost 8 or more (Your Attack Step) Invoke Flash
effects.text: Exhaust this Spirit ▶ Target one of your Cost 8 or more "Oceanic Green" family Spirits. During this battle, it gains an extra Green symbol.

cards.flavorText: It provides support using various types of bubbles as required. It seems far more intelligent than one might imagine from its appearance.

cards.name: The Immature Nere-Iro

effects.text: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, you can target an opposing Spirit. Exhaust it.

cards.flavorText: “I wish I could catch up to my older brother and sister soon...”

cards.name: Waltar

effects.text: This Spirit gains +2000 BP.
You can target one of your Spirits with [Current]. Refresh it.

cards.flavorText: t can run both on and in the water.

cards.name: Gaviadile

effects.timing: [LV1-2] Current Oceanic Green & Cost 8 or more (Your Attack Step) Invoke Flash
effects.text: Exhaust this Spirit ▶ Target one of your Cost 8 or more "Oceanic Green" family Spirits. During this battle, it gains an extra Green symbol.
This Spirit gains +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The silence before the attack. That tense moment felt like an eternity.

cards.name: Hammergrau

effects.text: You can target an opposing Spirit without on it. Exhaust it.

cards.flavorText: It isn't angry, nor dissatisfied. This is simply the only way it knows how to express itself.

cards.name: Carnabera

effects.timing: [LV1-2] Current Oceanic Green & Cost 8 or more (Your Attack Step) Invoke Flash
effects.text: Exhaust this Spirit ▶ Target one of your Cost 8 or more "Oceanic Green" family Spirits. During this battle, it gains an extra Green symbol.

cards.flavorText: Although it stood out clearly in the water, it did not seem the slightest bit worried about being attacked.

cards.name: Na-Nascita

effects.timing: [LV1-2] Current Oceanic Green & Cost 8 or more (Your Attack Step) Invoke Flash
effects.text: Exhaust this Spirit ▶ Target one of your Cost 8 or more "Oceanic Green" family Spirits. During this battle, it gains an extra Green symbol.
You can refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: Despite his seemingly sluggish appearance, he has mastered sharp swordsmanship.

cards.name: Tokkaricca

effects.text: [LV1-2](When Summoned) Target up to two Spirits with [Current] you control. Put a core from the Void to each of them.
You can target one of your Green Spirits. Refresh it.

cards.flavorText:
I was reminded of my cute bodyguard and, without thinking, reached out to touch it...and nearly lost a finger.
―from the Foreigners' Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

cards.name: The Alchemice Klite

effects.text: [LV1-2](When Summoned) You can target an opposing Spirit. Exhaust it.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, you can target one of your Spirits. Put a core from the Void to it.

cards.flavorText: She who makes a path upon the waters and walks upon it.

cards.name: The SeaMonster Morgawler

effects.text: (Legacy)
If you control any Spirit with [Current], you can target an opposing Spirit. Heavy exhaust it.

cards.flavorText: Not a loop, but a spiral. A mysterious spiral.

cards.name: Lione-Macina

effects.text: (Legacy)

cards.flavorText: Not a loop, but a spiral. A mysterious spiral.

cards.name: Gonpon

effects.text: Target an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. Return it to the Hand.

cards.flavorText:
It seems that all dogs are fond of mud.
―from the Foreigner's Chronicle of the Faraway Journey

cards.name: Morgoran

effects.text: If it's the opposing Attack Step, you can target one of your "Mineroid" family Spirits. Refresh it.

cards.flavorText: Mining and appraising. To identify the value that lies dormant within this land.

cards.name: Goztaurus

effects.text: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, if you control any "Meztaurus", you can draw a card.

effects.timing: [LV2] (True Release)Amplify Leucomyst +1000 (During Attack/Block)Invoke Flash(Once Per Battle)
effects.text: Pay one cost ▶ For each "Leucomyst" family Spirit you control, during this battle, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: I suppose he and his partner will continue to serve as guardians of the realm.

effects.text: While you control any "Armored Dragon" family Spirit, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Someone found a distortion in a vacant place. The invaders came from another world through the distortion to bring an end to this world.

cards.name: Baby-Loki
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
I attacked him with all my strength, but it was blocked completely with his hard shell. I stepped back to run from the monster's sharp fangs.
-From the 4th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The AutoLady Mani
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Send a core from your Trash to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: Shivering body of glass. The girl keeps working even with her body undermined. Just for the one who supports the world.

cards.name: Rainbowpapillon
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: While you control any Green spirit, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The lights of tiny insects lead them to the fascinating green lands which are slowly disappearing.

cards.name: Fenrircannon
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The beasts that bring destruction to the collapsing world. They press down the resistance and seek the eradication of life.

cards.name: The SilverScale Nithhoggr
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +4000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Gentle dragons who love peace. They confront the invaders with their silver body.

cards.name: Ur-Dine
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
"The world is dying." She said in a desperate voice over the silent back of the companion. "The humans and the earth both have lost the energy."
-From the 3rd paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Rabicrysta
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit can't be blocked by Red Spirits.

cards.flavorText: They search for the invaders' activities using their invisible bodies.

cards.name: Gatlingstand
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.flavorText: Each of the invaders has a different assigned command. He is supposed to march demolishing everything he sees.

cards.name: Elephantite
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +2000 BP.

cards.flavorText: They are the wretched resistance. They lost their lives one by one in fighting against the overwhelmingly powerful invaders.

cards.name: Queen-Valkyrie
cards.jpName: クイーン・ワルキューレ
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit can't become the target of opposing Spirit/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
The blazing flame didn't burn the opponent that time. The Flame Dance that I once had earned in another world vanished in vain.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: Metaldy-Bug
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Target a Spirit on each player's Field. Send a core from each of such Spirits to its owner's Trash.

cards.flavorText: The world has stopped moving. The winds don't blow and waves don't crash. The glow insects are just waiting to become shiny stones.

cards.name: Towermittcrab
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +1000 BP for each Nexus you control.

cards.flavorText: They are the watchers of this world. They watch out for the invaders keeping still.

cards.name: Dualcannon-Bell
cards.jpName: デュアルキャノン・ベル
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.flavorText: They are the guards of the gate of distortion. The gate of distortion comes and goes most unexpectedly. So, do they.

cards.name: Hell-Blindi
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Return a Spirit to its owner's Hand.

cards.flavorText: The one who fires lightning. He is a natural enemy of the flying whales. The ones who live on the back of the flying whales must run around when they face him.

cards.name: The Artifact Laguna
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: All your White Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The united intruders who are good at tactics. Taking the leader is the first thing you need to do to win.

cards.name: The CarrierWhale Mobileflow
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.flavorText: His mission is to protect the small lives. He glides the sky with them on his back.

cards.name: Gran-Dolbalkan
cards.jpName: グラン・ドルバルカン
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: By sending one core from your Reserve to your Trash, immediately end the battle.

cards.flavorText: Joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure. All life was silenced as the invaders appeared over the world.

cards.name: The ArmoredBeast Bear-Gelmir
cards.jpName: 鎧装獣ベア・ゲルミル
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: While the opponent controls no Red Spirits, this Spirit can't attack.
All your Green Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: Burning rage motivates him to protect the green lands until his body stops completely.

cards.name: The AutoEmpress Sol
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: If it is the opposing turn, skip the Attack Step. Or end it.

cards.flavorText: The glass throat invents beautiful songs that restore the world. Her songs are the only hope we have left on this world.

cards.name: The SteelWyvern Valkyrious
cards.jpName: 飛龍ヴァルキュリウス
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: This Spirit gains +6000 BP.

cards.flavorText: The body has been possessed by them. However, that's not enough to make him lose his hope. He keeps fighting against the invaders for his pride.

cards.name: The Burning Battlefield
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: All your attacking Spirits gain +1000 BP.
The opponents must block your first attack this turn if possible.

cards.flavorText:
The first battlefield where the battle between the dragons and dinosaurs occurred. The smell of blood drives even my heart to fight.
-from the Places of Interest 223/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Canyon Where Sage lives
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: You draw +1 card. After you draw, discard a card from your Hand.
You draw +1 card.

cards.flavorText:
The surfaces of the walls are filled with old paintings. The history of this world has been stored in this place by a clan.
-from the Places of Interest 13/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Canyon Where Sage lives — Card Art

cards.name: The Ruby Sun
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When using a White card, unless the player pay one extra cost, it can't be used.
Besides via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects, when cores are put onto, or removed from a White Spirit, exhaust it.

cards.flavorText:
The 2nd sun summoned by the dragons which refuses the night and forces people to keep being active.
-from the Places of Interest 531/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Ancient Dragon Territory
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When a Spirit is destroyed, send the cores on that Spirit to its owner's Trash, instead of the Reserve.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
The place where dragons used to live. The dragons worship this place and the dry winds still carry the traces of those dragons.
-from the Places of Interest 325/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Ancient Dragon Territory — Card Art

cards.name: The Lost of Old Castle
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: All your Purple Spirits gain +1000 BP.
If both players have the same number of cards in Hand, or the opponent has more cards than you, draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
The castle of a ruler before the law of evil world was established. Now it's a forbidden area and no one can enter. If you wish to see the inside, sneak in on your own responsibility.
-from the Places of Interest 411/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Lost of Old Castle — Card Art

cards.name: The Swamp of Drain Life
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Send all cores from the opposing Reserve to their Trash.
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
The swamp which takes lives of people who come close. They say that it has many bodies of nobles from the evil world in its depths.
-from the Places of Interest 412/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Swamp of Drain Life — Card Art

cards.name: The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spirit is exhausted, draw a card.
By sending a core from this Nexus to your Trash, destroy an opposing Spirit that blocked after this battle ends.

cards.flavorText:
The first and the last revolt against the nobles of the evil world. The outcome may easily be guessed.
-from the Places of Interest 224/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
cards.wikiTitle: The Historic Battlefield of the Cursed

cards.name: The Shackles of Doom
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Spirits with only one core on them can't attack/block.
After attack declaration, a core must be sent from the Spirit that attacks to the Trash.

cards.flavorText:
The grave of one of the Seven Shoguns who appeared in this world first. Has he been slumbering here waiting for a day of reincarnation.
-from the Places of Interest 444/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Shackles of Doom — Card Art

cards.name: The Hermit Wise Tree
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: For each exhausted Spirit you control, all your attacking/blocking Spirits gain +1000 BP.
Refresh all your Spirits.

cards.flavorText:
The Hermit Wise Tree which has been there since the initial stage of the woods. It told us a secret of the World Tree. I wonder if it survived the mass destruction by the Duke.
-from the Places of Interest 8/1000 or "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Hermit Wise Tree — Card Art

cards.name: The Fruit of Life
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When your Life is reduced by the opponent, draw a card.
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
They say that the fruit of the World Tree gives an eternal youth and immortality to the people who eat it. What do they lose in return?
-from the Places of Interest 118/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Fruit of Life — Card Art

cards.name: The Anthill
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When only the opposing attacking Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP during battle, refresh the blocking Spirit you control.
When only the opposing blocking Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh the attacking Spirit you control.

cards.flavorText:
The big colony of the Emeants. Seeing Emeants coming in and out from the tower is pretty spectacular.
-from the Places of Interest 801/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Hill of Violent Wind
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Refresh a Spirit with [High Speed you control.
When your Spirit is summoned, during this turn, it gets +1000 BP.] -

cards.flavorText:
A small hill which commands a good view of the entire woods which people believe to be the origin of the World Tree. A view of the woods will give you a better understanding of how unique it is.
-from the Places of Interest 802/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Hill of Violent Wind — Card Art

cards.name: The Timeless Ice Field
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: All your blocking Spirits gain +1000 BP.
Target an opposing Spirit. That Spirit must attack this turn.

cards.flavorText:
The field of ice that never melts and is not cold at all. Ever since the invasion, it became an ice that isn't ice.
-From the Places of Interest 126/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Timeless Ice Field — Card Art

cards.name: The Diamond Moon
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: When blocked by opposing Red Spirits, or when blocking an opposing Spirit, your Spirits get +1000 BP.
Destroy the opposing Red Spirit that battled with your Spirit at the end of the battle.

cards.flavorText:
The other moon that can partially be seen from the gate of distortion. It gives off cold lights as it takes the lives of all the living things.
-From the Places of Interest 612/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Castle of Eternal Snow
cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

effects.text: Return an opposing Nexus to the opposing Hand.
Return a Spirit to its owner's Hand.

cards.flavorText:
One of the hopes left on that island. it generates the clear singing voice like a glass and hinders any invasions.
-From the Places of Interest 26/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Castle of Eternal Snow — Card Art

The place has been invaded and changed like a board painted to be a set screen. It looked just like paper-mache that shines in silver.
-From the Places of Interest 256/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

Put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText: Do you know a spell that turns people into dragons? The dinosaur-slaying hero transforms more and more into a dragon for each enemy he defeats.

When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

cards.setName: Dawn of the Spirit (Call of the Core)

cards.flavorText: He is the greatest invader in the history who froze down the biggest city.

effects.text: The opponent must block if possible.

cards.flavorText: I'm getting the feeling that more and more characters I've never seen before are emerging in these parts... Could the gaping vortex that recently opened play a factor in this?

cards.flavorText:
Change is inevitable... No matter who wins this war, be it the Dragons of the Shooting Stars or the forces of the Empty Sky, this world cannot escape the changes destined to come.
-from the 15th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

When your Blue Spirit is summoned, destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit.

{The three servants of those who create the stars in the heavens shall transcend time and space to make their guided advent of destiny...} The three fantastic figures appeared before me, exactly like what happened last time.
-from the 5th paragraph in chapter Red of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The WildBeast Cruger

effects.text: Send two cores from your Trash to one of your Spirits.

cards.flavorText: It can't be helped if everyone went berserk. Battling endlessly day in and day out... Sooner or later, someone will crack. It's to be expected.

cards.flavorText: Unexpectedly, the Four Emperors have assembled! To lose here will be no laughing matter.

Destroy an opposing 3000 BP or less Spirit, and two opposing Nexuses.

cards.flavorText: This is bad, Lolo! If you get caught up in that, you'll fall into the vortex! Come this way, Lolo!! LOLO!!!

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] This Spirit is also treated as a Red Spirit.

effects.text: When your Red Spirit is destroyed, send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve.

cards.flavorText: There are those who gave away their body and soul to the Demonkin in order to gain the strength to fight....

effects.text: You can summon this Spirit card from the Trash when your Cost 5 Spirit is destroyed.

cards.flavorText:
What happens when an immortal is swallowed up by the Empty Sky? They slowly rise again, absorbing the lifeforce of their fallen comrades.
-from the 9th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

effects.text: For each "Shellman" family Spirit you control, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
All your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText: They can't be called "Rowdy Invaders" anymore. They too are getting desperate.

cards.name: The SunlightMusha Genji-Bolta
cards.jpName: 太陽武者ゲンジ・ボルタ

effects.text: The cores on your "Sun"-named Spirits can't be removed by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effects.
All your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirits gain +1000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
While walking alone on the battlefield, a Musha warrior inquires something to all he passes. It appears that he is pursuing a quest to decide a match with his fated archenemy. For him, the war is for finding and finishing things with his rival.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Windstorm: 2 - (When Attacks) When this Spirit is blocked, the opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.
[LV2] When your Spirits are destroyed by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effects, refresh all your Spirits with Windstorm.

cards.name: The EvilJupiterDragon Nobunagard-Sechst
cards.jpName: 木星魔龍ノブナガード・ゼクスト

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.
You can summon a Brave card and a Green Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your "Astral Deity"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit, refresh that Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
This isn't the charisma that I had admired!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Zaneegun

effects.text: This Spirit is also treated as a Red Spirit.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
My first order of work is to gather information on the 12 Zodiac Deities from the Solar and Lunar forces. Then, I am to find the Deities faster than them, and hold an audience with them. Here's where my skill comes into play: rather than the Deities taking sides with the Solar Militia or Lunar Brigade, I negotiate with them to support the future that Master has thought up.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.name: The ArtifactGuards Chrysanthe MK-VIII

effects.text: Either player's Life can't be reduced by attacks of Cost 0/1/3 Spirits.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
All your [The MoonlightDragonDeity Lunatech-Strikewurm] are also treated as Purple/Green Spirits.

cards.flavorText:
Since that Artifact Guard soldier is here, it means that the Moonlight Dragon Deity must be in this city as well. If either one of them falls, this war will come to an end here and now!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: The ArtifactGuards Chrysanthe MK-VIII — Card Art

cards.name: Sailfish

effects.text: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
All your White Spirits are unaffected by opposing Brave effects.

cards.flavorText:
Radiating seven-colored light and group swimming in the sea of the sunrise's glow, the golden meteor shower grants wishes.
—Astral Scholar Lyria, Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights, the Volans Chronicles—

cards.name: The IceLady Snotra

effects.text: When the opponent uses a Green/Yellow Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText: We possess a world frozen in time. Our friend Lolo, we wish for you to surpass us and take flight. In other words, this is where we part. We shall send you off now with maiden's song.

effects.text: [LV1][LV2] Heavy Armor: Purple/Green - This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Green Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
[When Braved] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step) All your White Spirits gain +3000 BP.

cards.name: Mechaniffon

effects.text: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Green Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.
Give all your Spirits this Spirit's [Armor].

cards.flavorText:
It's unusual for the Master to send a letter. Hmm... just as I thought! It was almost inconceivable, but Master was the one who broke the seal on the Three Astral Kings! She says it was to buy time, so that the war wouldn't end before my negotiations and spoil our plans. The Master is truly a rare beauty, but she's not picky about the means she uses to fulfill her convictions... even beautiful people have thorns, I suppose.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The HeavyBootsEmperor Vidar

effects.text: When the opponent uses a Purple/Green/White/Yellow Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.
When you use this Spirit's [Ice Wall] effect, by sending a core from this Spirit to your Trash, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText: The remaining Invaders took the lead. They gave everything up and left through the gate.

cards.name: Kogumaru

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.flavorText:
The play-biting becomes a clear assault; they have not the slightest idea.
—from the Ursa Minor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The Astronomer Pentan

effects.text: During this turn, give all your "Song Bird" family Spirits the "Astral Soul" family.

cards.flavorText:
When all of the Angels descend, the end will come to the world. The movement of the stars foretell this. It is an altogether ominous prophecy... Though the face of the teller made me laugh.
-from the 1st paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Angelia of Olimpics Phul
cards.jpName: オリンピアの天使フル

effects.text: You can send a core from this Spirit to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
At a dangerous point in my travels, when I was crossing over the Ruler Mountains, I became acquainted with a young girl. From what I heard, she has undertaken a dangerous mission for the Moonlight Dragon Deity. She won't regret losing her life if it's for him? I'd like to be told that too.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: The Angelia of Olimpics Phul — Card Art

cards.name: The StarDog Pomeran

effects.text: For each symbol on the opposing battling Brave Spirit, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
In this age of unending conflict, its often-isolated shape traps those who see it into grave confusion.
—from the Canis Minor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The Angelia of Olimpics Bethor
cards.jpName: オリンピアの天使ベトール

effects.text: When an opposing Spirit with two symbols attacks, during that battle, treat that Spirit's LV1/LV2/LV3 BP as 2000.
When your "Divine Spirit" family Spirits are destroyed, you can send one core from your Field to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
The rumors say that it's due to her that the charisma of the Eight Astral Dragons has fallen to darkness. She doesn't seem like a bad girl... Hm? She's carrying a forbidden spellbook in her arms!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: The Angelia of Olimpics Bethor — Card Art

cards.name: The Angelia of Olimpics Phaleg
cards.jpName: オリンピアの天使ファレグ

effects.text: For each "Divine Spirit" family Spirit you control, target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, those targeted opposing Spirits can't block.
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
Suddenly bursting through, carrying out a single-person head-first sliding maneuver. She folds her arms and looks down. That was how we met.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

galleryImages.caption: The Angelia of Olimpics Phaleg — Card Art

cards.name: The ClownPrincess Trickster
cards.jpName: 導化姫トリックスター

effects.text: Draw a card, and return a card from your Trash to the Hand.
Destroy an opposing battling refreshed Spirit.

cards.flavorText: We finally see each other again, but it's a little sad that we have to part so soon. But that's fine. We'll meet again for sure!

cards.name: The UranusDragonDeity Slei-Caelus
cards.jpName: 天王神龍スレイ・カエルス

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.
When the opponent uses a Magic effect, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.
When opposing Spirits are returned to the Hand, for each Spirit returned, put one core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
Pluto has fallen, and Neptune absorbs Mercury.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.name: Hinoki-Golem

effects.text: During this turn, treat all the reduction symbols of Nexus cards in your Hand as [Blue].
All your Nexuses are also treated as Blue Nexuses.

cards.flavorText: What an unexpected situation. Apparently the one responsible for the Master Unicorn's assassination was a Golem.

cards.name: The Hunter Condrad
cards.jpName: 大地の狩人コンドラッド

effects.text: At the start of the step, by exhausting this Spirit, during this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of Brave Spirits with two symbols.
The (When Summoned) effects of all Cost 3 or less Spirits can't activate.

cards.flavorText:
The divine earth inherited from the forefathers lets out a scream for the continuing great war. Knowing of its grief and wishing to end it, his forceful arrow shrieks and pierces through the enemy.
—from the Indus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

effects.text: No English effect text listed on this card.

cards.name: The BlackBeastKing Cepheus

effects.text: Treat all your "Beast Head" family Spirits as Spirits with no printed effect.
All your Spirits with no printed effects are treated as being at their highest levels.

cards.flavorText:
The one rampaging at the foremost line of the Solar Militia's vanguard was once king of a large country which boasted great prosperity. Having become involved in the world, his position changed, but his royal demeanor did not.
—from the Cepheus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: Nata-Golem

effects.text: When the opponent would pay the cost for Magic cards, they can't pay with cores on their Spirits.
Treat this Spirit as a Spirit without printed effects.

cards.flavorText:
Amazing! His agility is enough to match the spider girl's own unique speed! This guy uses a strange technique, too. Kong fu? Kung fu? Whatever it is. In any case, if that pretty guy with the eyepatch hadn't come along, she wouldn't still be alive.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The NeptuneDragonDeity Tri-Mercurius
cards.jpName: 海王神龍トライ・メルクリウス

effects.text: After paying for the summoning cost, you must send all cores from an "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control to the Void.
During the next (Opposing Refresh Step), the opponent can only return three cores from their Trash to their Reserve.
When the opponent pays the cost for Magic cards, the cores can't be paid from their Field.

cards.flavorText:
The Neptune Sacred Beast swallowed the Mercury Dragon Deity in one gulp and dove! He's the sole deity of the seas now!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Captain-Orcard
cards.jpName: キャプテン・オルカード

effects.text: Destroy every opposing Cost 11 or less Brave Spirit.

cards.flavorText: It looks like the time has come for us to say goodbye. Commentator Lolo, thank you very much. ...Now, I'm going to Galaxy-finish this! Take it away, Captain! See you, and keep up your battle!

cards.name: Amphisbaenar

effects.text: Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. Or, negate the effect of every opposing active "Seal"-named Magic.

cards.flavorText:
It's inexplicable how there's absolutely no information regarding the Bull Dragon Deity of Taurus or the Water Carrier Deity of Aquarius...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The ChargingMachineDragon Archaelancer
cards.jpName: 突機竜アーケランサー

effects.text: Draw a card, and destroy an opposing Nexus.
By exhausting a Spirit you control, during this turn, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
Attack target established. Hurry to the Skyscraper towering over the buildings!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The Exoskeleton Bone-Loader
cards.jpName: 鎧骨殻ボーン・ローダー

effects.text: Return an "Astral Deity"/"Galaxian"/ "Astral Soul" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

cards.flavorText:
The Dragon Brawler, caught in a web, was paraded through town as if celebrating his own achievement.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Death-Haze

effects.text: Destroy any number of Spirits you control, and draw a card for each Spirit destroyed. However, any (When Destroyed) effects of those Spirits can't activate.
By discarding a card from your Hand, this Spirit returns to the Field, exhausted.

cards.flavorText:
Raising the scythe held in his flexible arm, his enemy is silently decapitated from upon the rooftop.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Oodsutsunanafushi

effects.text: You can discard your entire Hand (at least one card). When you've done so, draw cards from your deck equal to the number of cards in the opposing Hand.
When the opponent draws, refresh this Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
It isn't strong enough to kill, but its accuracy is 99.8% - the top ranking among both forces combined!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Manekicat

effects.text: You can summon a Green/White Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirit can't activate.
The opponent exhausts a Spirit they control.

cards.flavorText:
There's an unusual belief among the Lunar Brigade saying that if you touch this guy's paw before going to the front, you're guaranteed to win.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Gecko-Glider

effects.text: During this turn, the Spirit braved with this Brave can't be blocked.
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Yellow Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

cards.flavorText:
The paratroopers that were training on the snowy mountain are being dispatched to the Skyscraper to eradicate the guerrillas.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Jet-Ray

effects.text: When your Life is reduced by opposing Spirit, if your Life is three or less, you can summon this Brave card from the Hand, without paying the cost.
Exhaust two opposing Spirits.

cards.flavorText:
The aircraft of the Solar Militia are being bombed from even higher in the skies! It's the latest model, with homing missiles equipped.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Hydrandea

effects.text: Summon three Cost 2 Spirit cards from your Trash, without paying the cost.
When the number of cores on this Spirit is brought to zero by an opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effect, this Spirit is treated as being destroyed at its highest level.

cards.flavorText:
The Evil Capricornus Deity of Capricorn heard me out! But I got invited to some strange religion...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The DivineBird Thunder-Bird
cards.jpName: 神聖鳥サンダ・バード

effects.text: Return a Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.
When you use a Magic card, after the effect resolves, during this battle, the LV1/LV2/LV3 BP of the blocking opposing Spirits is treated as 2000.

cards.flavorText:
The informant found out during his travels that the worrying truth that the Bull Dragon Deity has been captured by the Sun, and the Water Carrier Deity by the Moon.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Shoggoleth

effects.text: Treat this Spirit as a Spirit with no printed effects.

cards.flavorText:
The Neptune Sacred Beast's transformation, and the Pirate King's revival. The oceans are not calm as before.
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: Vulcan-Arms

effects.text: Draw three cards. Then, discard two cards from your Hand.

cards.flavorText:
The Solar Militia has sent in heavy street-combat tanks to their frontline! They've formed ranks and are firing their vulcan cannons!
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The Birthplace of the Sword

effects.text: When you would [Tribute], by exhausting this Nexus, treat all the cores on a Cost 3 "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control are sent to the specified area.
When Braves are summoned, you draw a card.

cards.flavorText:
There is said to be a legendary sword of unknown make and material that can withstand heat of any degree without melting. Collectors expect that the great war will be an impetus for it to appear in this world once again.
—from the Fornax chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

galleryImages.caption: The Birthplace of the Sword — Card Art

cards.name: The Steam-Breathing Mountains

effects.text: When your Spirit is exhausted by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effect, destroy an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to the exhausted Spirit.
While you control two or less Spirits, all your "Ancient Dragon" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest LV.

cards.flavorText:
A scene so beautiful as to sigh at, unfitting for this cruel world. It's a dangerous place, but even if you must bet your life, you should see it.
-from the Places of Interest 313/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

cards.name: The Brigade's Skyscraper

effects.text: Draw a card.
When your "Zombie" family Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
The setting for the final decisive battle is a skyscraper veiled in darkness that the Lunar Brigade now occupies. Immediately after the fight began, the Solar Militia continued their steady advance, but the Lunar Brigade made the most of their geographical advantage and launched a fierce counter-assault. At that moment, the skies split into two contrasting sides of light and darkness! It seems the end has begun at last...
—A memo from Negotiator Mix—

cards.name: The House of the Idol

effects.text: When you would [Tribute], by exhausting this Nexus, treat all the cores on a Cost 3 "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control are sent to the specified area.
When your Spirit is exhausted by an opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effect, for each Spirit exhausted, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

cards.flavorText:
Is the sculpture in the mansion where no one can enter the figure of a god or the embodiment of a devil? Nevertheless, as nobody can enter, this is all speculation.
—from the Sculptor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

galleryImages.caption: The House of the Idol — Card Art

cards.name: The Wooded Castle Tower

effects.text: The number of cores on your Green Spirits can't become less than their LV1 cost.

When an opposing Spirit attacks, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If the revealed card is a "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirit card, you can summon it without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.

cards.flavorText:
Was the building encroached by trees, or was it meant to be like this? I can't decide whether it's meant to be a spectacle or was a natural result, but it's worth seeing once.
-from the Places of Interest 880/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Wooded Castle Tower — Card Art

cards.name: The Gate of the Giant Trees

effects.text: When you would [Tribute], by exhausting this Nexus, treat all the cores on a Cost 3 "Astral Soul" family Spirit you control are sent to the specified area.
When your "Astral Deity"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit is destroyed, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

cards.flavorText:
Two giant trees supporting each other. I can't help but see them as the sun and moon. With the sun alone or the moon alone, the world will lose its balance. This very fallen tree is what I envision this world to become, and what should be realized.
—from the Circinus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
cards.wikiTitle: The Gate of the Giant Trees

galleryImages.caption: The Gate of the Giant Trees — Card Art

cards.name: The Moonlight Gathering Tower

effects.text: Your Hand is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effects.
All your Spirits with [Armor] are unaffected by opposing Brave effects of the same colors as their [Armor].

cards.flavorText:
The warriors of the Lunar Brigade continually bear serious injuries. Ether alone is extracted from the light of the paling moon, and is intensely discharged on their wounds. Their scars are healed in the blink of an eye, and their latent power is drawn out without sparing.
—from the Microscopium chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

galleryImages.caption: The Moonlight Gathering Tower — Card Art

cards.name: The Light Sacred Sword

effects.text: Give all your Spirits with [Armor]/[Heavy Armor] the effect: "Iw Purple/White (Opposing Turn) When the opponent uses a Purple/White Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect."
When your Brave Spirit is destroyed, the Brave of that Brave Spirit remains, and return only the Spirit to your Hand.

cards.flavorText:
Was it made to be wielded by anyone? A treasured sword shrouded in mystery, its origins and purpose are unknown. It appears to symbolize powers of brilliance such as life, the morning, and justice.
-from the Places of Interest 226/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Light Sacred Sword — Card Art

cards.name: The Ruler Mountains

effects.text: When the number of cores on your Spirits become zero due to opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effect, that Spirit is treated as being destroyed at its highest level.
Your Lives can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits with two symbols.

cards.flavorText:
There are few travelers who are not hurt by the steep triangular crags or the sharp grass. Also, if your luck is bad you may meet a strange angel; it's a dangerous place in many ways.
—from the Norma chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The Heaven's Stairway

effects.text: When your "Divine Spirit" family Spirit is summoned, return a Cost 4 or less "Divine Spirit" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.
While you control five or more "Divine Spirit" family Spirits, your Life can't become zero.

cards.flavorText:
The staircase leading to the Heaven's Door. Rather than being able to contemplate happiness on the way to paradise like what one would think, the stairs are so large, climbing them takes considerable effort. Going to Heaven is quite troublesome.
-from the Places of Interest 712/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo-

cards.name: The Unfinished Ancient Battleship:Sail

effects.text: Spirits with no printed effects you control are unaffected by opposing Magic effects.
The opponent can only summon one Spirit card with printed effects from their Hand per turn.

cards.flavorText:
The disappeared legendary constellation stands out on the great sail. Now that everything has been completed, it's only a matter of time until the revival of that Golem.
—from the Vela chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

galleryImages.caption: The Unfinished Ancient Battleship:Sail — Card Art

cards.name: The Pirate King's Treasure Island

effects.text: Spirits/Braves can't be summoned via Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
The opponent discards a Magic card from their Hand. If nothing can be discarded, the opponent reveals their entire Hand.

cards.flavorText:
A legendary island where dreams, romance, and adventure meet. Everyone wants to go, but finding the island is difficult. Not only is there the task of finding the island, there's finding the treasure that lies there. Is it two birds with one stone?
-from the Places of Interest 95/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-

galleryImages.caption: The Pirate King's Treasure Island — Card Art

effects.text: Destroy up to two Nexuses.
During this turn, give a Brave Spirit +5000 BP.
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add every "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul"/"Astral Dragon" family Spirit card/Brave card to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

cards.name: Bootes Call

effects.text: By using the cores on your Reserve to pay for the summoning cost and put on the Spirit for the summon, summon a Spirit card with [Immortality] from your Trash.

cards.flavorText:
Life and death...
These two phenomena thought to be polar opposites are simply 2 points drawn on the line of a circle. The more I think about it, the more similar they are.
—from the Bootes chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

effects.text: Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit.
During this turn, when your "Parasite"/"Shell Insect"/"Shellman" family Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to your Reserve, or that Spirit.
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

cards.name: Cassiopeia Seal

effects.text: This Magic card in Trash is unaffected by any effect.

Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Until (Your End Step) occurs five times, that Spirit can't refresh. After this effect resolves, put five cores from the Void beside your deck, and send one core to the Void on each of (Your End Step). Besides via this effect, these cores can't be used.
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
It shines on a powerful person's head and takes the person's freedom all day and night.
—from the Cassiopeia chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: Absolute Strike
cards.jpName: アブソリュートストライク

effects.text: Target any number of opposing Spirits as you like. During this turn, the targeted Spirit(s) must attack if possible. This effect can only be used if you control any "Strike"-named Spirits.

cards.name: Vacuum Symbol

effects.text: Target a color. During this turn, every opposing Spirit loses a symbol of the targeted color. This effect can't be used during (Your Turn).

cards.flavorText:
A cutting-edge apparatus that remains precise no matter how many hundreds of times it appears. No matter the age, its developer would gain much fame and fortune.
—from the Antlia chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: Melodious Harp

effects.text: During this turn, a Spirit loses all its effects, and can't gain any new ones. That Spirit is treated as having no printed effects.

cards.flavorText:
The melody of the soul that an angel strums. Its tone captures those who hear it and washes them away. All that remains afterward are pure souls.
—from the Lyra chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

effects.text: This Magic card in Trash is unaffected by all effects.
Put cores from the Void to your Life until it reaches seven. This effect can only be used if you control seven or more "Divine Spirit" family Spirits.
During this turn, give a Spirit +5000 BP.
Reveal three cards from your decktop. You can deploy a Nexus card among them, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.
During this turn, give a Spirit with no printed effects +5000 BP.

cards.name: Mercury Goblet
cards.jpName: マーキュリーゴブレット

effects.text: Destroy a Spirit with the lowest cost on the opposing Field.

cards.flavorText:
A great black hole in space that devours whoever... its way out is imagined. Neither common sense nor science can entirely explain the mysterious goblet.
—from the Crater chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The BullDragonDeity Dragonic-Taurus
cards.jpName: 金牛龍神ドラゴニック・タウラス

effects.text: Opposing Spirits must block if possible.
When blocked, compare the symbols of the blocking opposing Spirit to this Spirit's, and for each symbol more on this Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
When comparing symbols with this Spirit's effect, this Spirit gains an extra Red symbol for each "Astral Deity"/"Galaxian" family Spirit you control.

cards.flavorText:
He is in a world surpassing all knowledge.
—from the Taurus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

cards.name: The EvilCapricornusDeity Stein-Bolg
cards.jpName: 魔羯邪神シュタイン・ボルグ

effects.text: For each "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit you control, return a Purple card from your Trash to the Hand.
When your "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" family Spirit attacks, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
Cores to be sent to the opposing Reserve via Spirit/Brave/Magic effects are sent to the Trash instead.

Dan lost consciousness and drifted in the outside world.

effects.text: Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if you have five counter or less, your counter +1.
When an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks, this Spirit refreshes.

cards.flavorText:
Stark, who was separated from Dan due to the attack from the Olym Primordial Deities, washed up in Artemis' world. It was a world of Machine Beasts. While walking on a wasteland shone bright in moonlight, a female appeared before Stark. And she was Artemis, the goddess of Moon, and the sister of Apollon.
-"Thenogonic Record" Fragment-

cards.name: The SteelKnight Cleomenes
cards.jpName: 鋼鉄機士クレオメネス
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: By discarding this card from the Removed Zone, deploy an "Athena" from your Removed Zone/Soul State.
Discard an opposing Burst, and when you couldn't discard, return an opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card onto your Removed Zone.

cards.flavorText:
The power of contract...By contracting with Dan, Apollon has held back the primordial deities for a good while. Regretfully, the contract concluded back at that time was incomplete, and hence couldn't last long enough. More research is needed.
―Grandwalker Athena―

cards.name: The SteelKnight Phalaicos
cards.jpName: 鋼鉄機士ファライコス
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: You can return an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit to the deckbottom. Or, you can +1 core to one of your "Contractor Athena" Grandwalker Nexuses.
You can put a core from the Void to any White "Devotee"/"Concluser" family Spirit you control. When you've done so, if all your "Athena" Grandwalker Nexuses are on LV1, your counters +2.

cards.flavorText:
Dan, a drifter who could travel across various worlds by his own power. Could that mean he has the same power as us? Although I've heard that his power as a singularity is lost after the Judgment berserk incident in Lecoulis...This is so intriguing.
―Grandwalker Athena―

cards.name: The SteelMaiden012 Alcyone
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: Return three opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the deckbottom, and put two cores from the Void to any "Concluser" family Spirits you control. After this effect resolves, put this card onto your Removed Zone.
You can put a core from the Void to your Trash.

cards.flavorText: "Hi, and welcome to Acropolis! This is one of the Steel Cities under the protection of Lady Athena, and it is governed by my elder sister! Hope you can find the clues about Contract Grandwalkers you want in the Divine World Library~"

cards.name: The SteelKnight Stratos
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
By exhausting one of your White-only Spirits, during this turn, give a Spirit you control +3000 BP. When you've done so, once per turn, your counter +1.

cards.flavorText:
Only a few knows about the Primordial Deities...Among the twelve Olympians, only Lord Zeus, Lord Poseidon, and Lady Demeter, the second generation deities know. Lady Hera simply doesn't like the fact that Hades is going to seize the real power...But Lord Poseidon is displaying such a stern attitude, and even Lady Demeter is supporting Hades...Is there something behind all these that we don't know?
―Grandwalker Athena―

cards.name: The SteelMaiden002 Eufemia
cards.jpName: 鋼鉄乙女002エウフェミア
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: (Once per Turn: Same Name) Return a White "Android" family card from your Removed Zone to the Hand, or summon it by paying one cost. After this effect resolves, put this card onto your Removed Zone.

When the opponent uses any White/Yellow Magic card, if you control any "Contractor Athena", before that effect activates, by exhausting a "Devotee"/"Concluser" family Spirit you control, immediately negate that effect.

cards.flavorText: "The primordial deities are the first generation Grandwalkers of Oylm that were exiled by Lord Zeus. They should be monitored by Lord Hades...I wonder what happened..."

cards.name: The DinosaurMobile Defendic-Spino
cards.jpName: 恐竜機動ディフェンデック・スピノ
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

Once per turn, by paying two costs, look at the contents of one card from your decktop, and return it to either the decktop or deckbottom.
By paying two costs, during this battle, give a "Silver Zero" family Spirit you control +10000 BP.

cards.flavorText:
Excellent! Thank for all your support, everyone from Winglass!
Waltrud "You will pay for the price. Be ready♥"

cards.name: Railgunner-Foresight
cards.jpName: レールガンナー・フォーサイト
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.timing: Flash - [Contract Advent: Machine Contract & C3 or more ((Either Attack Step))]
effects.text: By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.
This Spirit can block every opposing "can't be blocked" Spirits/Ultimates.
At the end of battle, you can draw a card. Then, you can target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. During this turn, that target must attack next if possible.

cards.name: The SteelKnight OwlUser Ignatios
cards.jpName: 鋼鉄機士 梟使いのイグナティオス
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

When blocked, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
You can discard an opposing Burst. Then, if you control any "Contractor Athena", during this battle, this Spirit gains an extra White symbol.

cards.flavorText:
Hades, who then became the leader of Olym, announced his contract with Dan the drifter. It is settled that contract powers would be used as the main plan to combat against the primordial deities.
―Theogonic Record Volume 1―

galleryImages.caption: The SteelKnight OwlUser Ignatios — Card Art

cards.name: The SteelMaiden008 Tryphaena
cards.jpName: 鋼鉄乙女008トリュファイナ
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

cards.flavorText: "Lord Hades is so cool for real! How can he be so handsome??? Among the twelve Olympians, Lord Apollon is the wild type, Lord Hermes is the punk type, and Lord Dionysus is the type with a dark past...Finally, we got the intellectual type!"

cards.name: The VeteranSteelKnight Mithridates
cards.jpName: 歴戦の鋼鉄機士ミトリダテス
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.timing: Burst After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves
effects.text: Return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.
You can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the deckbottom.

cards.flavorText:
The Steel Knights who survived Divine World War surely looks different. You say they all look the same? Each of them is unique and looks so different though.
―Grandwalker Athena―

cards.name: The ChalkSteelKnight Gennadios
cards.jpName: 白亜の鋼鉄機士ゲンナディオス
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

All your White "Devotee"/"Concluser" family Spirits are unaffected by opposing Nexus effects and Mirage effects.

cards.flavorText: "Have you heard about the prototypes of the Steel Maidens? They say that the first four that were made have powers equivalent to the Steel Knights."

cards.name: Arcanabird-ClubOwl
cards.jpName: アルカナバード クラブオウル
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP, and destroy it when it becomes 0 BP.
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's a "Golden Cloud" family card, you can draw a card from the deckbottom. Return the revealed card to the decktop, face-up.

cards.flavorText:
Feaniel was separated from Dan due to the attacks of the Olym Primordial Deities. And where she eventually arrived, was Aphrodite's world.
―"Theogonic Record" Fragment―

cards.name: Nut kun
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: If you control any "Contractor Kinich-Ahau", during this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't block.
When blocked, draw a card from the deckbottom; when not blocked, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
Ok, understood! Find this guy who is called Dan, and help him out, right? Leave it to me, Creator!
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

cards.name: Kamikiri File
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.
You can draw a card from the deckbottom. Then, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Kinich-Ahau", your counter +1.

cards.flavorText:
Searching for Dan, Kinich-Ahau travelled across various worlds of Olym. As he approached the center of Olym, however, he found that he was interrupted by the primordial deities more and more frequently. And while he was still on the way, Olym had fallen under Hades' control, and it was announced that Hades had contracted with Dan. Hearing that, he immediately headed towards Elies, the world of Hades.
―Thenogonic Record Volume 1―

cards.name: Maimai Measure
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

Your counter +1. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) if the opposing Life is at four or more, and you control any "Contractor Kinich-Ahau", during this battle, this Spirit can't be blocked, and is unaffected by opposing effects.

cards.flavorText:
Kinich-Ahau, a Grandwalker from Vulrica, sneaked into Olym chasing after Dan. However, Dan was then caught in the fight caused by the Olym primordial deities.
―Thenogonic Record Volume 1―

cards.name: Parrot Wrench
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: When this card is sent to the Trash by the effect of your "Contractor Kinich-Ahau", you can summon it by paying one cost.
This Spirit in refreshed state can't be destroyed by opposing effects. Also, when an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit attacks, put a core from the Void to your Life.
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText: Kinich-Ahau is the Grandwalker of Puppet Beast Spirits that take the form of various tools. DIY is exactly his forte. It is said that he could build even a log house by himself.

cards.name: Bison Jigsaw
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: [During Set] When your Spirit with "Holy Life"-named effects attacks, if you control any "Contractor Kinich-Ahau", you can draw a card from the deckbottom. Then, during this battle, the effect of every opposing LV1 Nexus can't activate.
When blocked, draw a card from the deckbottom; When not blocked, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
Hey, make a contract with me! Contracting with Hades also isn't your first time doing contracts I thought. I want to get stronger!
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

cards.name: Tooled Fighter
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: (Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Life is increased or reduced, if you control any "Contractor Kinich-Ahau", you can summon this card from the Hand by paying one cost. When you've done so, you can refresh a "Puppet Beast" family Spirit you control.
You can draw a card from the deckbottom.
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText: "Kinich, everyone knows you are trying your best to protect this world. However, I have to object to your use of that outlaw, Gigo-Tool."

cards.name: Beast Pliers
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

When your "Puppet Beast" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can send cores from your Life, one to each of those Spirits. Spirits which have core sent to them via this effect remains on the Field, exhausted.

cards.flavorText:
Ok ok, Plier. Calm Down. Don't keep barking because he is a stranger. So you're Dan? I've heard about you from my brothers.
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

cards.name: Tortoise Drill
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can return a "Puppet Beast" family Spirit card/Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

During this turn, a "Puppet Beast" family Spirit you control can only be blocked by opposing LV2 Spirits.

cards.flavorText:
Contract Grandwalkers? What's that?
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

cards.flavorText:
I wonder...is there any ways for us to travel to the Divine World?
―The PartnerBird Feaniel―

cards.name: Vultur Chainsaw
cards.jpName: バルチャチェーンソー
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.timing: Flash - Mani "Contractor Kinich-Ahau" & C5 or more (Either Attack Step)

When blocked, draw a card from the deckbottom; when not blocked, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
So the Olyms have screwed it up, having the primordial deities revived. The balance of the Divine World is probably going to change.
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

cards.name: Gigant Hammer
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.timing: burst After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned/Advents) effect resolves
effects.text: Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, return opposing LV1/LV3/LV5 Spirits/Ultimates, one of each, to the deckbottom.
When blocked, draw a card from the deckbottom; when not blocked, put a core from the Void to your Life.

cards.flavorText:
You mean where do I come from? Sorry but I can't tell you that.
―Grandwalker Kinich-Ahau―

cards.name: Specimen No.6 Fropper
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: (Can't Stack) When Magic cards are discarded/banished from the opposing deck via your "Azure Wave" family effects, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.
Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's level from opposing decktop.

cards.flavorText:
Taking in the news that Oylm was now in Hades' control, and that he had contracted with Dan, the Olym primordial deities moved. Uranus, a first generation Grandwalker of Olym, then made an announcement.
Uranus "Olym, we're back! It's time for you to return us the world that we, the primordial Grandwalkers, created!"
―Theogonic Record Volume 1―

cards.name: The SpacePirate Cali-Harius
cards.jpName: 宇宙海賊カリ・ハリアス
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

While you control another "SpacePirate", this Spirit gains: "mt Purple/Blue Besides (When Deployed) effects, your Purple/Blue Mirage also activates its LV1/LV2 Nexus effects."

cards.flavorText: "A bunch of never-before-seen Spirits are hurtling towards Olym. A big storm is gonna come."

cards.name: Folly-Golem
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's level from opposing decktop.

When Spirit cards/Ultimate cards are discarded from the opposing deck by your [Crush], once per turn, your counter +1. When Nexus cards are discarded, once per turn, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

cards.flavorText:
Dan is caught in the war against the Olym primordial deities. Which means that the search for Contract Granwalkers could only be postponed until the war is over. And at this point of time, a mysterious Grandwalker, Kinich-Ahau, suddenly shows up before Dan. What is he after?
―Theogonic Record Volume 1―

cards.name: The SteamNobleThief Latimer
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

Discard two cards from the opposing decktop.

cards.flavorText:
Latimer "It seems like Gladstone is becoming the major of Steamhive!"
Lucy "Ohh~ That means One-Horn won't be able to interfere this city's development anymore!"
Salinjack "It means that our efforts have paid off. This city is going to be better than ever!"
Dalnia "By then, we should be able to go outside with Reve together!"

cards.name: The GrandseaBeast Daiou-Manticore
cards.jpName: 神海獣ダイオウ・マンティコア

After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.
Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's level from opposing decktop.

cards.flavorText:
Interesting! So this is what a Spirit from the Divine World looks like! A form like this that is gross to its fullest doesn't exist in Lecoulis!
―The PartnerShark Shack―

cards.jpName: 審判獣デッド・レガレクス
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

cards.flavorText:
What happened during the Judgment in Lecoulis would be recorded here.
―Lecoulis Judgment Record―

Put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

Discard a number of cards equal to this Spirit's level from opposing decktop.
This Spirit's symbol is fixed as zero.

cards.flavorText:
Ah, this's bad. It's not the time to look for Contract Grandwalkers.
―The PartnerShark Shack―

cards.name: The SteamNobleThief Winchelsea

cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.timing: Burst After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks

cards.flavorText: "That's so troublesome. I'll just leave it to Gerald! What? Dalnia-chan is coming too? You should've told me about that earlier!"

cards.name: The SpacePirate Captain-Gorgordes
cards.jpName: 宇宙海賊キャプテン・ゴーゴルド
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: When your Cost 5 or more "Space Pirate" attacks, you can immediately activate this set card.

effects.timing: burst After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent
effects.text: Put cores from the Void to a Purple/Blue Nexus with Mirage effects you control so that it becomes LV2. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Cost 6 or more "Oracle"/"Space Pirate" would leave the Field due to opposing effects, they can remain on the Field in the same condition.

cards.flavorText: "Hey hey! We have more attacks to come! Just shut up and watch!"

cards.name: The Sun Tree
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: (Once per Turn: Same Name) When you activate the [Grand Skill]/[Contract Skill] of your "Apollon" Grandwalker Nexus, you can draw a card.
Once per turn, when your Red-only "Devotee"/"Concluser" family Spirit attacks, +1 core to one of your "Apollon" Grandwalker Nexuses.

cards.flavorText:
A common kind of plant in Apollon's world that burns like the Sun. The original one is placed at the deepest part of Apollon's Shooting Stardragon Temple, while its seed are granted to the outside worlds.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 131―

cards.name: Hades' Nether Temple
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

(Can't Stack) When an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit/Ultimate attacks, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Hades", you can send a core from the attacking target to the Trash.

cards.flavorText:
The main temple located at the center of Elies, the majestic temple city in Hades' world. The Nether doesn't exactly refer to a physical world, but an intangible world connected by the spiritual part of various worlds.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 609―

cards.name: The Secret Book of Thunder
cards.setName: Contract Saga: True Vol. 1 – Battle of the Gods

effects.text: (Once per turn : Same name) When your "Jade Thunder" family Spirits/Braves are summoned from the deck, your counter +1, and put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
Once per turn, you can summon a "Jade Thunder" family Spirit card from your Hand, or summon one of your set "Jade Thunder" family Mirages.

cards.flavorText:
A scroll which contains secrets that are passed down in Amahara. It is rumored that if you could master what is written on it, you could appear out of nowhere like thunder, and move as fast as lightning.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 421―

galleryImages.caption: The Secret Book of Thunder — Card Art

cards.flavorText:
Newly built by Athena to fight the primordial deities.
―Genesis Records" Divine World Map 557―

cards.flavorText:
Kinich-Ahau's temple governs the Sun. It is a handmade temple contracted, built, and painted entirely by Kinich-Ahau himself.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 385―

cards.flavorText:
The eyes of the sea serpent can see through the opponent's weakness.
―"Genesis Records" Divine World Map 827―

galleryImages.caption: The Sea Serpent Eye's Odachi — Card Art

You want me to fight again? Hmmph, the Primordial Deities...are indeed a troublesome lot. But I already lost the power that I used to have...? Oh, Athena's armor. You're well-prepared. True to your name of being the most intelligent guy in Olym.

―"Theogonic Record" Volume 4―
